caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #82: QUIXOTIC

quixotic (adjective): idealistic in an unrealistic way.

✅ In a sentence: His quixotic plan to clean the entire ocean by himself never got off the ground.
✅ Similar: idealistic, impractical, utopian
✅ Remember it: From Don Quixote, who attacked windmills.
